integrity.proof_type: finite exact regular cellular quotient, genuine collapses, Tietze word eliminations and standard simply-connected homology-to-homotopy argument
integrity.result_claim: Full geometric quotient is homotopy equivalent to four two-spheres.
integrity.source_provenance: Original queen-placement literature and a separately credited nonequivariant five-by-five topology calculation.

scientific_limitations: Applies only to the ordinary nonperiodic five-by-five queen-placement complex and its full eight-element square-symmetry group.
Does not classify proper symmetry-subgroup quotients or complexes on larger boards.
The finite proof is supplied as reproducible exhaustive computation; an independent expert audit has not been performed.
Indexed literature searches cannot eliminate unindexed equivalent earlier work.
title: The full square-symmetry quotient of the five-by-five queen placement complex is four two-spheres
